fields.issue: Every lattice and aerogel in this table was tested as a laboratory specimen (micrometres to centimetres); the float-ceiling core is about 1257 m2 by 0.19 m. The commercial foams (EPS, melamine, polyimide) are made at larger scale but fail the checks by orders of magnitude. Vacuum outgassing, creep under a sustained p/2 (polymer foams), and temperature were not assessed.
fields.numbers: No lattice or aerogel source here reports a manufacturing route at metre scale.
fields.closes_when: a manufacturing route at metre scale is sourced for a candidate core.
